description: Comparable ASX companies for one company: same GICS sub-industry (widening to industry, then industry group, only when fewer than 3 match; each row says matchedOn), market cap within 0.1-10x, ordered by size proximity, each flagged for a raise in the last 12 months, M&A involvement and cash runway. Suited to 'peers', 'comparables', 'competitors' and 'how does X stack up' questions, which need an enumerated size band. Free.
name: find_peers
title: Find peers
